title: [dev-i] Bolus insulin record not transferred to NSClient phone
symptom: After bolusing with the bolus calculator, the bolus record appears in AndroidAPS and Nightscout but is not visible in the NSClient phone's graph or treatments tab. Restarting the app and phone did not help.
fix: Clearing cache and data of the NSClient app and reconnecting to Nightscout prevented further missed boluses, but did not recover already missed records. The maintainer suggested trying the dev branch of NS.
evidence_quote: I did go to the phone app settings for NSClient on my phone on Sunday evening, cleared cache and data, and connected "clean" to NS again. It did not bring back the already missed bolus records, but I haven't had another missed bolus since.
